A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Q-T, T-P, and cycle length (C), as measured in the ECG, do change with change in the heart rate and that the changes in the T-P and Q-T are not necessarily parallel, as is the case with systole and diastele as measured by mechanical methods.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the QT interval is a marker of ventricular repolarization.
the T-P interval is a more reliable measure of the duration of ventricular systole and dias-tole than is the Q-T interval.
the T-P interval is a better measure of the duration of ventricular repolarization than the Q-T interval.
